cases.rationale: Crop alignment: In all four bottom crops the magenta detected quadrilaterals nest tightly within or alongside the cyan expected quadrilaterals, both following the physical black-and-white tag borders; only minor stroke-width offsets are visible and the 'id 0' text extending outside polygons is permitted. Full-frame inspection: The enlarged frame shows numerous tagged cubes on the ground, each with cyan/magenta overlays aligned to their visible tag faces; no magenta quadrilaterals float on the road, robot, or empty background, and no clearly displaced polygons are visible. Banner metadata: Header reads 'AprilTag overlay | 12 expected | 12 detected', family tag36h11, basename 33369213973_9d9bb4cc96_c.jpg, and source sha256 prefix 6f2888334e654405 — all matching the task requirements. Geometry and metadata both pass; strong reviewable evidence.

Crop alignment: In the bottom crops, cyan quadrilaterals tightly follow the printed tag borders, but magenta detected outlines are essentially absent or only stray magenta segments appear (e.g., a magenta line above the tag in crop 3) rather than overlapping the cyan perimeters, so the crops do not demonstrate aligned detections. Full-frame false/shifted polygons: The enlarged full frame contains numerous clearly visible magenta quadrilaterals floating on empty road, on/near the robot body, and displaced well above and beside the actual tag cubes, none of which coincide with cyan/tag perimeters — these are clear false or shifted detections. Banner metadata: The banner matches the expected basename (33369213973_9d9bb4cc96_c.jpg), SHA prefix 6f2888334e654405, 12 expected / 12 detected, and family tag36h11, so metadata is correct; however the geometry fails decisively with displaced magenta polygons, making this a clear failure.

The supplied review sheet is effectively blank: no top enlarged overlay, no bottom pixel crops, no cyan expected quadrilaterals, no magenta detected quadrilaterals, no physical AprilTag, and no banner/header text are visible anywhere in the frame. Crop alignment cannot be assessed because there are no crops; full-frame inspection shows no polygons at all (neither aligned nor displaced); banner metadata (source basename 33369213973_9d9bb4cc96_c.jpg, SHA256 prefix 6f2888334e654405, 12 expected / 12 detected, tag36h11 family) is entirely absent and unverifiable. Per the rubric, a blank image is a clear failure.

Crop alignment: In the bottom crops, cyan and magenta quadrilaterals appear to track the physical black-and-white tag borders closely, with magenta nested just inside cyan consistent with stroke-width differences; 'id 0' text spill is permitted. Full-frame: the detected magenta polygons in the enlarged frame appear to sit on visible tag faces with no obvious displaced or floating polygons on road/robot/background. Banner metadata: FAIL — the banner shows source basename '34139872896_defdb2f8d9_c.jpg' (expected '33369213973_9d9bb4cc96_c.jpg'), SHA prefix '435a619d642e2d50' (expected '6f2888334e654405'), and counts '10 expected | 10 detected' (expected 12/12). The tag36h11 family matches, but the wrong source, hash, and counts mandate failure even though geometry looks acceptable.

scope: Four disclosed request/provenance integration controls. Not a new independent holdout or physical-policy qualification.
